notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
[h1][i]Hello fellow Galactic Sweepers![/i][/h1]

We've got a 2nd-day update for you with the following adjustments: 

[h3][b]Content:[/b][/h3]
- New bounty hunters ship animation.
- Changed font and adjusted some texts.
- New boss enemy graphics on the last planet.
- Crispier mobs graphics. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105449/c8d52a1ec2147999a46638ac0f3329c722d6999a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3]
- Buffed land mines.
- Adjusted some unlocks requirements for upgrades.
- Adjusted volume of Grenades SFX.

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]
- Adjusted planet objective overlapping with options on pause menu.
- Fixed Grenades Explosion SFX not reacting to SFX volume change.
- Fixed wrong player number when the first player left from the multiplayer lobby.
- Fixed problem that prevents multiplayer games to be restarted.
- Fixed problem that prevents players who killed every enemy fast enough to progress.
- Fixed graphical glitch caused by killed mobs.
- Fixed problem that caused game to start multiple times.
- Fixed some typos.

[h2][b]JOIN THE GANG![/b][/h2]
Join our space crew and be the first to know everything about Sector Sweep! We love to hear some voice in the space void: 

➡️ [url=https://discord.gg/Fzva3jgXtY]Discord[/url]
➡️ [url=https://www.facebook.com/sectorsweep]Facebook[/url]
➡️ [url=https://twitter.com/sectorsweepgame]Twitter[/url]
➡️ [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SectorSweep/]Reddit[/url]

Good luck, Soldiers!

notes.title: Sector Sweep OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Soldiers, 
you've been trained for this the whole time. Now show what you learned to those bad guys in the galaxy! It's time to split into groups and sweep the next sectors! 

[h2][b][i]SECTOR SWEEP[/i] IS NOW ON STEAM![/b][/h2] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/918780/Sector_Sweep/
[b]Buy the game in the first week with a -10% discount, gather your friends and jump straight into action! [/b] Choose one from many Sector Sweepers and clean the next planets from ever-growing enemies. Unlock new sectors by defeating enemies and upgrading your weapons or hero powers. Make your mama proud, and be the best Sector Sweeper the company ever had! 

[h2][b][i]SECTOR SWEEP[/i] TRAILER[/b][/h2] 
[previewyoutube=mV6eCjPH6dA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]MEET THE TEAM![/b][/h2]

[h2][b]Hunter[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=FpnR4WDCs34;full][/previewyoutube]
The mysterious Hunter never shows their face. A former smuggler and gunrunner with nothing to lose, and a ton of gun experience under their belt - they were the perfect fit for a leader of the Sector Sweepers guild. And so, the legend was born.

The Hunter serves as the current captain of the GSS Dynasties.

[h2][b]Masty[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=UCL5P05cMbI;full][/previewyoutube]
Demolition Expert, short and simple. This hound specializes in grenades, land mines and all other kinds of bombs. If there's something that needs to explode, the Mongrel is your boy to do it.

Masty has some Unfinished Business with Don Albino, that he doesn't want to talk about.

[h2][b]Curlicue[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=6pGkTO7S_5o;full][/previewyoutube]
Sergeant Curlicue is a former army engineer, and a veteran of the second galactic war. Her engineering brain is the sole reason the ship still operates in one piece, after all those years.

She is the current ship navigator, focused on transporting the crew safe to the next sector marked for sweeping.

[h2][b]Charlie[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=L1xAWC_HHSQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Originally, a part of the neural network governing the GSS Hercules. Currently, the AI is operating an autonomous body known simply as Charlie. This core team member of the Sector Sweepers always know how to raise the team spirit.

The AI seeks revenge on their nemesis, the Big Wheelie, the main factor behind Charlie's ship's demise.

notes.title: Sector Sweep RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
Bounty Hunters! 
It's time to gather your team, a gear of your choice, and sweep another planet from enemies! Are you up for the challenge? 

Moonlit proudly presents the newest title in our portfolio: [b]Sector Sweep[/b]! Read more about our upcoming game! 

[h2][b]SECTOR SWEEP[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=DO3xTvWYv60;full][/previewyoutube]

Sector Sweepers need your services again! Gather your friends and together discover new mysterious planets full of precious technology and materials worth a fortune. Take a gear of your choice, and get ready to rumble against numerous enemies!

Play as one of many bounty hunters in this top-down roguelike shooter with space-western elements. Explore undiscovered and mysterious planets full of various hazards, including aliens, robots, or just plain bad guys. Upgrade your equipment, improve your abilities, and collect loot from planets that no one dares to fly into. Remember: You can play solo, but some quests are easier to complete in a gang of bounty hunters. Use Remote Play Together, and gather your friends into a clean-up crew of relentless star exterminators! 

[b]The game will be launching in Early Access on 3rd November 2022 on Steam.[/b] 
We want to create and improve this game with our players. That's why we decided to launch it this way. Thanks to our previous title - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164250/Model_Builder/]Model Builder[/url] - we got the necessary experience working closely with the community and developing the game together.
